author: The Infographics Show
description:
Elon Musk built a $1.25 trillion AI empire overnight. Then his entire team vanished. Something went very wrong behind the scenes.

In 2026, Elon Musk merged SpaceX with xAI, promising a future powered by rockets, satellites, and superintelligence. At the center was Colossus, a record-breaking supercomputer built at extreme speed and cost. On paper, it looked unstoppable.

But hardware alone isn’t enough. As Grok struggled to compete with rivals like OpenAI and Google DeepMind, key engineers and co-founders began leaving one by one.
By March 2026, almost the entire founding team was gone.

What happened reveals a deeper truth about AI. Talent, stability, and long-term vision matter more than raw power. And without them, even the biggest empire can start to look empty.
